experiment: bounded Unity resource-memory MPC prior smoke test
comparison_note: The preceding 19.885-minute passive refractory run recorded 51 pickups, 447 body-collision frames, 43 stuck frames, and four new stuck events. This is contextual rather than causal: the runs were not a reset matched pair, and the resource prior changed zero selected actions in the guided run.
analyzer_note: The generic passive analyzer marks passive causal separation false when the score bonus is evaluated. That passive-only check is not the guided smoke-test criterion; selected-action changes, gating, and the configured weight bound are the relevant intervention checks.
conclusion: The bounded guided integration behaved as designed but did not exercise motor authority. One of three recalled targets was approached and followed by a pickup 4.43 m from the target, yet every guided MPC selection matched its unguided counterfactual. Safety and authority bounds are supported; resource-memory motor efficacy remains unproven, and the guidance weight should not be escalated from this run.
